title: Sell with an order form and one-click upsell
blurb: Take payments on a funnel page, then offer an extra with one click.

steps.title: Open Sites
steps.body: You will need a payment provider such as Stripe connected in **Payments** first. Click **Sites** in the left menu.

steps.title: Open Funnels
steps.body: Click **Funnels** and open the funnel you want to sell from.

steps.title: Attach your product
steps.body: Pick the checkout step and open its **Products** tab. Click **Add Product** and choose what you are selling and its price.

steps.title: Add the order form
steps.body: Click **Edit** on that step. From the order elements, drag **One Step Order** (or the two-step version) onto the page. It collects contact, address and card details.

steps.title: Add an order bump (optional)
steps.body: In the order form settings, switch on the order bump to offer a small add-on with a tick box, like an extra year of warranty.

steps.title: Add an upsell step
steps.body: Back in the funnel, click **Add New Step** to add a page after checkout. Open its **Products** tab and attach the upsell product.

steps.title: Set the one-click button
steps.body: Edit the upsell page, click its main button and set the action to the one-click upsell option with your upsell product. The customer does not need to re-enter their card.

steps.title: Test before going live
steps.body: Put your payment provider in test mode and run through the whole funnel. Check the order appears in **Payments** > **Orders**.
